correctness.rationale: The proof defines the full six-edge Boolean lattice and positive-screened/unregularized limits. The exact independent standard-library checker computes det(mu I+L_S)/mu for all 64 subsets and every one of 240 elementary submodularity comparisons. The -Delta numerator factors as a positive prefactor times q(mu) in exactly one case, and 210 other nonzero numerator polynomials have strictly positive constant and nonnegative remaining coefficients after the substitution mu=v+5/4; 29 are identically zero. Descartes and rational signs isolate a unique root of q between 5/4 and 13/10. An explicit unscreened comparison is 3/70. Exhaustive exact polynomial identities, not floating-point sampling, prove all real-parameter quantifiers.

The exact quartic restoration statement was not found in the searched literature or accessible previous scientific claims. This is an evidence-qualified originality assessment, not a guarantee of publication priority.

value.rationale: The object is the canonical five-node graph used in the published correction disproving greedy network-coherence submodularity. The result gives its exact minimum uniform screening strength needed to restore all diminishing-returns inequalities over every possible missing edge, rather than merely resolving the original three-chord witness. This resolves a natural control-design boundary with a sharp exact quartic and a reproducible complete proof; it does not claim a general graph theorem or an algorithmic improvement for unbounded network sizes.
